First release of **Transport** — a music player that shows you what you hear.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | How to start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `Transport-Windows-x64.exe` | Just run it. No installer, no runtime needed. If SmartScreen warns, click *More info → Run anyway* (the app isn't code-signed yet). |
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon & Intel) | `Transport-macOS.zip` | Unzip, move to Applications, then **right-click → Open** the first time (not notarised yet). |
| Linux x64 | `Transport-Linux-x64.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./Transport`. |

## What's in it
- **Player:** album art from tags (MP3/FLAC) or folder images, file info, play/pause/next/previous through the folder, volume, drag & drop.
- **Waveform:** smooth playhead, hover time readout, click/drag to seek, A–B loop.
- **10 plugins for the slots:** VU meter, Peak/RMS, Loudness (EBU R128 — momentary, short-term, integrated), Spectrum analyzer, Spectrogram, Oscilloscope, Polar stereo field, Goniometer, Phase correlation, Retro LED bars.
- **Slots without a cap:** add, replace, remove, drag to reorder, 1–6 columns; the window grows when a new row starts.
- **Quick access:** 16 functions (monitoring menu, mono, swap L/R, solo L/R, mid/side, dim, bypass, A–B loop, playlist, always on top, compact mode, snapshot…) — right-click a button to assign, grid 2×2 / 3×2 / 4×2.
- **Animation:** everything is driven by the display refresh rate — needle physics, meter ballistics, play/pause morph, sliding slots, crossfades.

## Keyboard
`Space` play/pause · `← →` seek 5 s (`Shift` 30 s) · `↑ ↓` volume · `N` / `P` next / previous · `M` mono · `L` A–B loop · `Ctrl/Cmd+O` open

## Known limitations
- Builds are not code-signed / notarised yet.
- No EQ yet (the monitoring button opens mono/solo/mid-side instead).
- Plugin slots are all the same size for now.
